meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: When the user wants to create SEO-driven pages at scale using templates and data. Also use when the user mentions "programmatic SEO," "template pages," "pages at scale," "directory pages," "location pages," "[keyword] + [city] pages," "comparison pages," "integration pages," "building many pages for SEO," "pSEO," "generate 100 pages," "data-driven pages," or "templated landing pages." Use this whenever someone wants to create many similar pages targeting different keywords or locations. For auditing existing SEO issues, see seo-audit. For content strategy planning, see content-strategy.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用模板和数据批量生成SEO优化页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为不同关键词或地区创建大量相似页面
copy.tagline_en: Generate SEO-optimized pages at scale using templates and data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create many similar pages targeting different keywords or locations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你用模板和数据批量创建 SEO 页面，比如“城市+服务”页、对比页、目录页等。它会先了解你的业务和目标，然后设计页面模板、内部链接和索引策略，确保每页有独特价值，避免内容重复。
howto.when: 当你提到“程序化 SEO”、“模板页面”、“批量生成页面”、“[关键词]+[城市]页面”、“对比页面”等，或者想为不同关键词/地点创建大量相似页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我为每个城市生成牙医服务页面，用模板和数据。
say.note: Claude 会询问业务细节，然后设计模板和策略。

say.text: 用我的产品数据生成 100 个目录页面，每个页面介绍一个工具。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供数据源，然后设计页面结构。
